title: Your Saturn return is not a deadline.
caption:
Saturn takes about 29.5 years to orbit the Sun, returning around ages 27 to 30. Astrologers read it as a growing-up chapter.
It's a check-in, not a deadline for love. Send this to the auntie with the soup.
